open_points.subject: public_op:source_folder.read_named_source
open_points.question: Does read_named_source read a file on every call, or only after the requested name and its path pass condition 1 of A3 rule 5?
options: Always read one file once, as the observable effect states.
For a name that fails condition 1, open no named file or link target and return nothing, as INV-02 and A3 rule 5 require.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the effect as conditional: validate the path without following links and read the terminal file once only when condition 1 passes.

witness.initial: A confirmed project has no placement for the requested source id, and its photo folder contains a symbolic-link path segment whose target contains the named file.
events: The calling flow requests delivery using the path through the symbolic link.
A file-open trace records every path opened during the call.
outcomes: Following the unqualified observable effect, read_named_source reads one file once.
Following INV-02 and A3 rule 5, it returns nothing and opens neither the named file nor the link target.
witness.observer: The calling flow and the file-open trace see whether the named file or link target was opened.

open_points.subject: public_op:photo_delivery.mark_photo_published
open_points.text: Reads the clock once and writes the mark when there is none.
open_points.question: Does every mark call read the clock once, or does a call refused before its source id is accepted read it zero times?
options: Every invocation reads the clock once, including one with an invalid source id.
The clock is read once only after the token, request form and identifiers are accepted; an earlier refusal reads it zero times.
open_points.default_guess: Follow A7 rule 2 and public_op:system_clock.utc_now: do not read the clock when the source id or another earlier request element is rejected.

witness.initial: The service uses a counting clock and has a confirmed project; the request carries a valid token and form but a source id that does not match SOURCE_ID_PATTERN.
events: The calling flow submits a publication-mark request.
module:photo_delivery validates the source id and refuses the operation.
The test reads the clock's call count.
outcomes: The unqualified observable effect makes the clock count become one before the refusal.
A7 rule 2 leaves the clock count at zero because the source id was not accepted.
witness.observer: The counting-clock test sees the different call count.
